ARCH_ENG_FUEL_LEVEL.content:
The engine interface fuel level provider reads the analogue tank level
sensor every 100 ms, averages it over 10 s against fuel slosh and provides
the fuel level in percent of the tank capacity (1 % resolution) to the VCU.
ARCH_ENG_FUEL_LEVEL.title: Fuel level provider

ARCH_ENG_TORQUE_INTERFACE.content:
The engine torque interface converts the VCU traction power limit into a
torque limit at the current engine speed and sends it to the engine control
unit as an SAE J1939 torque/speed control (TSC1) message.
ARCH_ENG_TORQUE_INTERFACE.title: Engine torque interface

ARCH_VCU_ENERGY_DISPLAY.content:
The VCU energy display manager reads the remaining energy in percent from the
energy source of the product (BMS state of charge or ENG fuel level), derives
the remaining range from it and the average consumption of the last 50 km,
and sends both to the instrument cluster once per second.
ARCH_VCU_ENERGY_DISPLAY.title: Energy display manager

ARCH_VCU_POWER_MGMT.content:
The VCU traction power manager limits the torque request to the power limit
divided by the current motor speed. The power limit is the vehicle limit; in
battery-electric products it is the lower of the vehicle limit and the
permitted discharge power published by the BMS.
ARCH_VCU_POWER_MGMT.title: Traction power manager

IMPL_ENG_TORQUE_LIMIT.title: Torque limit from the traction power limit

REQ_ENERGY_SOURCE.content:
The vehicle shall display the remaining energy as the fuel tank level, in
percent of the tank capacity with a resolution of 1 %.
REQ_ENERGY_SOURCE.title: Remaining energy display

REQ_RANGE_ESTIMATE.content:
The vehicle shall display the estimated remaining range in kilometres with a
resolution of 1 km, calculated from the remaining energy and the average
consumption of the last 50 km (the nominal consumption until 50 km are
driven). Energy source of this product: :variant:`powertrain.type`.
REQ_RANGE_ESTIMATE.title: Range estimate

REQ_TRACTION_POWER_LIMIT.content:
The vehicle shall limit the traction power measured at the drive axle to the
value of this requirement, with a tolerance of 5 %.
REQ_TRACTION_POWER_LIMIT.title: Traction power limit

SWREQ_ENG_FUEL_LEVEL_REPORT.content:
The ENG software shall report the fuel level as the 10 s average of the tank
level sensor in percent of the tank capacity, rounded to 1 %.
SWREQ_ENG_FUEL_LEVEL_REPORT.title: Report filtered fuel level

SWREQ_ENG_TORQUE_LIMIT.content:
The ENG software shall send the torque limit, calculated as the traction
power limit divided by the current engine speed, in a TSC1 message every
10 ms.
SWREQ_ENG_TORQUE_LIMIT.title: Send engine torque limit

SWREQ_VCU_ENERGY_DISPLAY.content:
The VCU software shall send the remaining energy of the energy source to the
instrument cluster in percent, rounded to 1 %, once per second.
SWREQ_VCU_ENERGY_DISPLAY.title: Send remaining energy

SWREQ_VCU_POWER_LIMIT_APPLY.content:
The VCU software shall limit the torque request to the active power limit
divided by the current motor speed.
SWREQ_VCU_POWER_LIMIT_APPLY.title: Apply traction power limit

TEST_ENG_FUEL_LEVEL_REPORT.title: Fuel level is the averaged sensor value

TEST_ENG_TORQUE_LIMIT.title: Engine torque limit follows the power limit

TEST_VCU_ENERGY_DISPLAY.title: Remaining energy is rounded to percent

TEST_VCU_POWER_LIMIT_APPLY.title: Torque is limited by the power limit

TRES_ENG_TORQUE_LIMIT__TRUCK_DIESEL_EU.title: Engine torque limit follows the power limit (truck_diesel_eu)

TRES_VCU_ENERGY_DISPLAY__TRUCK_DIESEL_EU.title: Remaining energy is rounded to percent (truck_diesel_eu)

TRES_VCU_POWER_LIMIT_APPLY__TRUCK_DIESEL.title: Torque is limited by the power limit (truck_diesel_eu)

US_PREDICTABLE_POWER.content: As a driver, I can rely on a known maximum traction power of my vehicle.
US_PREDICTABLE_POWER.title: Predictable traction power

US_RANGE_AWARENESS.content: As a driver, I know the remaining energy and range of my vehicle.
US_RANGE_AWARENESS.title: Range awareness

arch.description: Mapping of uml key to uml content.

chain_reqs.description: Requirement ids this test result is evidence for, via test -> swreq -> arch -> req.

chemistry.description: BMS: pack cell chemistry a chemistry-specific need is resolved for (NMC or LFP).

code_url.description: Remote URL of the code marker (codelinks). Nullable: the BMS export carries null.

constraints.description: List of constraint names, which are defined for this need.

constraints_error.description: An error message set if any constraint failed, and `error_message` field is set in config.

constraints_passed.description: True if all constraints passed, False if any failed, None if not yet checked.

constraints_results.description: Mapping of constraint name, to check name, to result, None if not yet checked.

content.description: The main content of the need.

docname.description: Name of the document where the need is defined (None if external).

doctype.description: The markup type of the content, denoted by the suffix of the source file, e.g. '.rst'.

external_css.description: CSS class name, added to the external reference.

external_url.description: URL of the need, if it is an external need.

gap_category.description: Which gate reported this gap: trace_backward, trace_forward, orphan, status_disallowed, ...

gap_link.description: The link name the reporting gate counted, when the gap is a trace gap; empty otherwise.

gap_need_id.description: Id of the need the gap is attributed to, as a field a report template can read.

gap_need_type.description: Type of the need the gap is attributed to, so a report can group gaps by V-model level.

gap_shortfall.description: How far short the need fell, as a label: "<have> of <need>" links present.

has_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list.

has_forbidden_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list, and the link type does not allow dead links.

is_external.description: If true, no node is created and need is referencing external url.

is_import.description: If true, the need was derived from an import.

is_modified.description: Whether the need was modified by needextend.

jinja_content.description: Whether the content was pre-processed by jinja.

layout.description: Key of the layout, which is used to render the need.

lineno.description: Line number where the need is defined (None if external).

outcome.description: Recorded outcome of one test case in one run: passed, failed, error or skipped.

parts.description: Mapping of parts, a.k.a. sub-needs, IDs to data that overrides the need's data

post_template.description: The template key, if the post_content was created from a jinja template.

pre_template.description: The template key, if the pre_content was created from a jinja template.

product.description: Product the evidence (test result, gap) belongs to; one of configs/*_defconfig.

runtime_s.description: Wall-clock runtime of that test case, in seconds, as the report recorded it.

signature.description: Derived from a docutils desc_name node.

style.description: Comma-separated list of CSS classes (all appended by `needs_style_`).

template.description: The template key, if the content was created from a jinja template.

test_run_label.description: Identifier of the test run the outcome came from: the report's timestamp, as a label.

value.description: Product-specific value of a vehicle requirement, resolved per product (variant functions).
